rounds.text: The market is currently mispricing the company’s capacity for rapid expansion, as evidenced by the 69% compounded sales growth achieved over the last three years [E14]. While recent performance shows volatility, this three-year growth trajectory significantly outpaces the sector median sales growth of 7.5% [E61]. The current valuation at a price-to-book ratio of 2.61x reflects a market that has priced the stock at the very bottom of its 52-week range [E1, E4]. Conceded: [E3], [E7], [E8], [E13], [E15], [E55], and [E56]. This extreme pessimism ignores the underlying momentum demonstrated in the medium term [E14]. Investors are currently ignoring the potential for a turnaround, as the stock sits at the floor of its historical range despite the demonstrated ability to scale revenue aggressively [E4, E14].
